notes: Interrogative הֲ takes the fronted *Is* and the positive existential יֵשׁ keeps only the presentative *there* (rules 17, 50); the supplied *any* in the question joins מִסְפָּר under rule 15.
Second clause has no yes/no particle (מִי holds *whom*), so the fronted *doth* stays with יָקוּם under rule 17.
